falsy-flag.condition: Only `False` -> `None` for allow_nan, annotate_fields, sort, index, replace, check or ignore_index. `True` -> `None` (for example `exist_ok`, `parents`) is not in the class.
falsy-flag.title: False replaced by None for a flag read as a truth value

name-case.condition: Only a quoted name of three letters or more that changes case alone, in `version(...)`, `tz_localize(...)`/`tz=` (utc), `kind=` (stable), `unit=` (min) or `decode(...)`. One-letter units are not in the class (`m` and `M` differ). It says nothing about the dependency range: the owner's reason for `inconclusive` on 2026-11-11 was exactly that.
name-case.title: case of a name the library reads without case

signed-division.condition: Holds when the operand is a float array or a float; an integer operand gives float for `/` and integer for `*`. The operand's type is not checked by this builder: it must be read per mutant.
signed-division.title: division by -1 for a multiplication by -1

split-limit.condition: `text.split(sep, n)[0]` is the part before the first separator for any limit n >= 1 or none; the class holds only when the new limit is at least 1 or absent.
split-limit.title: limit of a split whose first part is read
